id: 24_Replace the Display Screen for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊机：更换显示屏
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/24_Replace the Display Screen for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/24_Replace the Display Screen for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K7: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线
points.K8: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏
points.K9: 新屏入支架，排线对缺口

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光焊接机旁，指着机器顶上的显示屏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine and points at the touch screen on its top.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换显示屏。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换显示屏

shots.scene: 四个图标：撬棒、螺丝刀、显示屏、贴膜
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a pry tool, a screwdriver, a display panel and a screen protector sticker. No people.
shots.narration: 揭膜、拆屏、换屏、贴新膜。

shots.scene: 阿杰点着焊接机顶上的触摸屏，屏幕没有反应
shots.prompt_en: The young male student taps the touch screen on top of the laser welding machine, but it does not respond.
shots.narration: 焊接机的显示屏坏了。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱和新显示屏走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer comes over carrying a toolbox and a new display panel.
shots.narration: 老李带着新屏来更换。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们看看具体步骤。

shots.scene: 台面上两把十字螺丝刀、黑色撬棒、镊子
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a wooden bench with two cross-head screwdrivers, a black plastic pry tool and tweezers. No people.
shots.narration: 5毫米和3毫米十字刀、撬棒和镊子，

shots.scene: 一块新显示屏和一张黑框空白贴膜
shots.prompt_en: A new display panel with a green circuit board back and a blank black-framed screen protector sticker on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 还有新显示屏和新保护膜。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拔下电源插头和其他线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine and unplugs the power cord and other cables.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉全部线缆。

shots.scene: 老李把四个脚轮锁扣踩下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake levers of all four caster wheels.
shots.narration: 锁好底座四个脚轮。

shots.scene: 老李用撬棒撬起保护膜的一个角
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts one corner of the screen protector with the plastic pry tool.
shots.narration: 用撬棒把保护膜四个角撬起来，

shots.scene: 老李用手把保护膜整张揭下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the whole screen protector off by hand.
shots.narration: 再整张揭下来。

shots.scene: 露出的金属支架边缘有一些残胶
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the metal screen bracket with small spots of leftover glue along its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 支架上有残胶的，清理干净。

shots.scene: 老李用小号十字螺丝刀拆下支架螺丝，放在机器顶面上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the bracket screws with a small cross-head screwdriver and leaves them on top of the machine.
shots.narration: 用3毫米十字刀，拆下8颗螺丝。

shots.section_title: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线
shots.scene: 老李双手抬起屏幕组件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the screen assembly up from the top of the machine with both hands.
shots.narration: 抬起屏幕，背面连着一根排线。
overlay: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线

shots.section_title: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线
shots.scene: 老李用镊子剥掉排线上的胶，再拔下排线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels glue off the ribbon cable with tweezers, then unplugs the cable.
shots.narration: 排线上有胶，先用镊子剥掉再拔。

shots.section_title: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏
shots.scene: 屏幕放在台面上，老李拆背面螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The screen assembly lies face down on the bench; the facility engineer removes the screws on the back.
shots.narration: 用5毫米十字刀，再拆8颗螺丝。
overlay: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏

shots.section_title: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏
shots.scene: 旧屏和金属支架分开放在台面上
shots.prompt_en: The old screen and the empty metal bracket lie separately on the bench with the screws beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 旧屏从支架上取下来。

shots.section_title: 新屏入支架，排线对缺口
shots.scene: 新屏放进支架，黄色软排线对准支架缺口
shots.prompt_en: The new screen is placed into the bracket; a yellow flexible cable lines up with a notch in the bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 新屏放进支架，黄色软排线对准缺口。
overlay: 新屏入支架，排线对缺口

shots.scene: 老李拧紧屏幕背面的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the screws on the back of the new screen.
shots.narration: 拧紧8颗螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把排线插回屏幕背面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the ribbon cable back into the back of the new screen above the machine.
shots.narration: 回到机器上，接回排线。

shots.scene: 屏幕放回机顶，老李拧紧支架螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The screen assembly sits back on the machine top; the facility engineer tightens the bracket screws.
shots.narration: 放回屏幕，拧紧其余8颗螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李揭开新贴膜背纸，对准屏幕四角
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the backing off a new blank screen protector and lines up its corners with the screen.
shots.narration: 贴新保护膜，先对齐四个角，

shots.scene: 老李用手掌把贴膜均匀抹平
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smooths the protector evenly with his palm.
shots.narration: 再均匀地抹平。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the machine with icons floating behind: a plug, a pry tool, a display panel and a sticker.
shots.narration: 关机拔线锁脚轮，撬四角揭旧膜。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 排线有胶先剥，黄排线对准缺口。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰在焊接机前挥手，屏幕亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye beside the laser welding machine with its screen lit.
shots.narration: 显示屏换好了，下次见！
